items.title: An ergodic interval exchange transformation has an infinite connection time
items.author: Przemyslaw Berk; Frank Trujillo
items.work: Ergodic properties of infinite extension of symmetric interval exchange transformations
items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author's labelled corollary at source lines 220-222: an ergodic interval exchange transformation has a connection time equal to infinity. The proof (source lines 224-226) is a contradiction argument whose whole force comes from reading the preceding criterion correctly: the negated conclusion supplies finiteness of the connection times, the criterion then produces a finite decomposition of the interval into semi-closed periodic components, and it is the ergodicity hypothesis that this decomposition contradicts, since such a decomposition is invariant and non-trivial. The statement records only the existence of an infinite connection time and neither the criterion applied nor the invariance of the decomposition.
